column1: # WHAT THIS IS: the bytes an INDEPENDENT re-implementation of OpenBYD 2.4.2.1's
# SOME/IP encoders says must go on the wire for each input frame below. Written
# in Python from the decompiled reference, then validated against the held-out,
# on-car-proven Ui7Variant goldens (5/5 byte-identical) BEFORE any LauncherMapCn
# WHAT IT IS NOT: third-party source. These are hex bytes we generated. The
# oracle script itself is scratchpad-only and is never committed.
# WHAT A GREEN TEST AGAINST THIS PROVES: we transcribed the protocol faithfully
# — topic set, emit order, field numbers, wire types, varint encoding, sentinel
# SCOPE (TASK-019/ISSUE-004): that transcription claim holds across ALL vectors.
# The stronger reading — 'every field VALUE was independently predicted' — holds
# only where the oracle derives the value itself. Fields whose value is passed in
# rather than derived agree by construction and are NOT independent evidence:
# ui7 f28 (D1, 2.3.2 semantics), ui7 f31 in the 9 real-fix vectors (D3, our
# formatting), ui7 f26/f30 CONTENT (D2/D4 — stubbed on BOTH sides, so untested
# rather than merely divergent), and f8 content (D0, excluded by design).
# WHAT IT DOES NOT PROVE: that the constants are right for an L8 or an L5 LR.
# A byte match reproduces the reference's constants EXACTLY, per-car calibration
# and all. That risk is untouched and stays pending on-car verification.
# Field 8 (the maneuver icon PNG) is compared by PRESENCE and LENGTH-PREFIX
# FRAMING only, never by content: we draw our own glyphs, they load BYD's
# assets. Divergence there is by design and on legal grounds.
# DO NOT regenerate these to make a failing test pass. A diff here means the
# TASK-018 CORRECTION (D5): the lane field-2 bytes below were originally
# generated with a 'zeroed' override that encoded OUR port's reading rather
# than the reference's, so the fixture agreed with our bug by construction.
# The override is gone; field 2 now carries the reference's RAW sentinels
# (inactive lane = 0xFF), which is what this file has always claimed to be.
# The correction moved 3 lane-bearing lmc vectors, field 2 of the lanes topic
# only; no UI7 vector and no other field moved.
# TASK-019 CORRECTION (ISSUE-003): the trip-progress no-fix position was also
# overridden, to 0.0/0.0, on the strength of a claim that the reference's
# location helper 'returns 0 when it has nothing'. It does not. LocationHelper
# is ONE static singleton pre-seeded to 39.9042/116.4074 and only ever
# overwritten by a real fix; LauncherMapCnStrategy reads the same getters as
# AlternativeUi7Strategy. So with no fix the reference emits the stub, not null
# island. Override gone; fields 11/12 are now derived like ui7's 19/20. The
# correction moved 11 of the 20 lmc vectors, fields 11/12 of the trip-progress
# topic only; no UI7 vector, no other field, no event-count or order change.
# Columns (tab separated): kind name counter maneuver distance remDist remTime
#                          road laneCodes laneActive lat lon events
# events = topic:hex;topic:hex;...   '~' = null   empty field = absent/empty
